question: As per Livestock Census of India 2019, which of the following categories of livestock has recorded the highest population?
solution:
The correct answer is __**cattle**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• According to the Livestock Census of India 2019, the cattle population was recorded to be the highest.
 
• According to this census conducted in 2019, the total number of cattle was 192.49 million, which is a large part of the total livestock population.
 
• This census provides important data for livestock management, planning, and policy making.
 
• Cattle are mainly used in milk production, agricultural work, and various economic activities.
 
• The total livestock population was recorded at 535.78 million in the Livestock Census 2019, with cattle being the most prominent category.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Livestock Census**

 
 
• Livestock Census in India is conducted every 5 years.
 
• This census provides detailed information about the number, type, and use of animals.
 
• The purpose of livestock census is to understand the importance of animals in agriculture and rural economy.
 
 
 
• **Importance of cattle**s
 
 
• Cattle play an important role in India's rural economy.
 
• They are used for milk production, manure making, agricultural purposes, and transportation.
 
• India is the world's largest milk producer, and cattle play a significant role in this.
 
 
 
• **Other Categories of Livestock​**
 
 
• Buffalo: Buffalo population is also quite high in India, and they play an important role in milk production.
 
• Goat: Goat rearing is an important source of income in rural areas in India.
 
• Sheep: Sheep are mainly raised for wool production and meat.
 
 
 
• **Livestock Management**
 
 
• Livestock management focuses on nutrition, vaccination, and breeding.
 
• The government encourages the development and conservation of livestock through various schemes.
 
• Better health services for livestock and use of modern technology help in increasing their productivity.
